definition.en: The passage through which air moves when breathing. Includes the nose, mouth, pharynx, larynx, trachea, bronchi, and bronchioles.
definition.tl: Ang passage kung saan gumagalaw ang hangin kapag humihinga. Kasama ang nose, mouth, pharynx, larynx, trachea, bronchi, at bronchioles.

definition.en: Complete absence of electrical and mechanical activity of the heart; cardiac standstill. Represents a non-shockable cardiac arrest rhythm.
definition.tl: Kumpleto na kawalan ng electrical at mechanical activity ng puso; cardiac standstill. Kumakatawan sa isang non-shockable cardiac arrest rhythm.

definition.en: The time it takes for color to return to the skin after pressure is applied and released. Normal is less than 2 seconds. Used to assess perfusion in patients.
definition.tl: Ang oras na kinakailangan para ang kulay na bumalik sa balat pagkatapos ang pressure ay i-apply at i-release. Normal ay mas mababa sa 2 segundo. Ginagamit upang suriin ang perfusion sa patients.

definition.en: A bluish discoloration of the skin and mucous membranes due to inadequate oxygenation of the blood.
definition.tl: Isang bluwish discoloration ng balat at mucous membranes dahil sa inadequate oxygenation ng dugo.

definition.en: Difficulty breathing or shortness of breath. Can be a symptom of various medical and trauma conditions.
definition.tl: Difficulty sa paghinga o shortness of breath. Maaaring maging symptom ng iba't ibang medical at trauma conditions.

definition.en: Abnormal accumulation of fluid in body tissues, resulting in swelling.
definition.tl: Abnormal accumulation ng fluid sa body tissues, na nagreresulta sa swelling.

definition.en: Coughing up blood or blood-tinged sputum from the respiratory tract.
definition.tl: Pag-ubo ng dugo o blood-tinged sputum mula sa respiratory tract.

definition.en: Excessive bleeding, either internally or externally. Classified as arterial, venous, or capillary based on the source.
definition.tl: Excessive bleeding, alinman internally o externally. Naka-classify bilang arterial, venous, o capillary batay sa source.

definition.en: Inadequate oxygen supply to tissues. Can lead to tissue damage if not corrected promptly.
definition.tl: Inadequate oxygen supply sa tissues. Maaaring magdulot ng tissue damage kung hindi corrected agad.

definition.en: Inadequate blood supply to a part of the body, often due to blockage of blood vessels. Can lead to tissue death.
definition.tl: Inadequate blood supply sa isang parte ng katawan, madalas dahil sa blockage ng blood vessels. Maaaring magdulot ng tissue death.

definition.en: Wounds caused by blunt force trauma that results in irregular tears in the skin and underlying tissues.
definition.tl: Wounds na sanmimistula ng blunt force trauma na nagreresulta sa irregular tears sa skin at underlying tissues.

definition.en: Death of tissue cells due to disease, injury, or inadequate blood supply.
definition.tl: Death ng tissue cells dahil sa disease, injury, o inadequate blood supply.

definition.en: The circulation of blood through body tissues and organs to deliver oxygen and nutrients.
definition.tl: Ang circulation ng dugo sa buong body tissues at organs upang maghatid ng oxygen at nutrients.

definition.en: Collapse of a lung due to air entering the space between the lung and chest wall.
definition.tl: Collapse ng puso dahil sa air na pumapasok sa space between ang puso at chest wall.

definition.en: A critical medical condition characterized by inadequate tissue perfusion and oxygenation. Types include hypovolemic, cardiogenic, distributive, and obstructive.
definition.tl: Isang critical medical condition na characterized ng inadequate tissue perfusion at oxygenation. Ang types ay kasama ang hypovolemic, cardiogenic, distributive, at obstructive.
